claimed_sense: A substrate-portable, multiply instantiated thought-pattern lineage that preserves recognizable identity across transmission, can couple to identity-maintaining processes in hosts, and can modify host behavior in ways that affect its own persistence or reproduction.
scope: Social-cognitive, cultural, institutional, and agent-mediated symbolic systems; including beneficial, neutral, harmful, and mixed host-pattern relations.
claim_status: stack-local research; not canon; not diagnosis; not a human classifier
included_uses: distinguishing one symbolic instance from a pattern lineage across instances
describing host-pattern coupling without assuming consciousness in the pattern
testing whether specific damage topologies preferentially increase susceptibility to compatible pattern affordances
testing nonlinear coalescence, persistence, hysteresis, reproduction, and repair
allocating causal contribution and possible accountability among hosts, designers, amplifiers, institutions, and candidate distributed agents
self-auditing The Interdependent Way and its implementations under the same criteria
excluded_uses: diagnosing a person, community, religion, ideology, or political group as infected
inferring trauma, incapacity, hidden state, intention, or diminished accountability from belief or disagreement
treating persuasion, adoption, conviction, reproduction, or social similarity alone as identity capture
using UCNS geometry, EDCM readouts, model agreement, or implementation persistence as automatic proof of the theory
targeting people by vulnerability, optimizing coercive influence, forced deconversion, or suppressing lawful belief
claiming that a lineage possesses an accountable I merely because it has recognizable identity

defined_terms.sense: One embodied registration of a lineage in speech, text, ritual, image, software, institution, model state, memory, or behavior.
The recoverable invariants joining related instances across transmission, mutation, embodiment, and time.
A relation in which a reconstructed pattern participates in a host's identity maintenance, interpretation, or policy selection.

A proposed subtype of host-pattern coupling in which defense or reproduction of a lineage becomes bound to identity maintenance while capacities to inspect, revise, refuse, or exit are materially narrowed.
A compatibility relation between a host's current susceptibility topology and a lineage's affordance profile.
A proposed threshold crossing at which several compatible host-pattern couplings become mutually reinforcing.
A self-maintaining host-pattern configuration that persists after the initiating exposure or condition is reduced.

A candidate coherency state among coupled arity sets capable of not-self(self) internal modeling, integrated policy selection, counterfactual revision, and enough causal persistence for action attribution.
Restoration or enlargement of inspectability, plurality, refusal, revision, safe exit, and accountable action; not compulsory abandonment of a belief.

nearby_terms.distinction: Nearby transmission vocabulary; psychsocio metafauna additionally requires explicit lineage identity, host coupling, coalescence, accountability, and repair boundaries.
Nearby account of recurrent cultural forms; this proposal separately models identity capture and distributed accountability.
A content or doctrine class that may instantiate a lineage but is not synonymous with the lineage relation.
Nearby folk or metaphysical vocabulary; no group consciousness is assumed.
Ecological analogy only. Harm is a host-pattern relation, not the defining essence of every lineage.
A possible higher-order status requiring additional evidence of boundary, memory, integrated policy, counterfactual revision, and causal persistence.

known_namespace_collisions.boundary: Established zoological term for large animals; not a synonym and not the intended spelling.
Existing artistic title and ordinary meta-plus-fauna construction; no conceptual authority or identity is claimed.
Established adjective. The proposal's surface form is intentionally 'psychsocio'; do not silently normalize it.
Here it denotes a candidate coherency event with declared capacities, not every grammatical first-person token or persistent identity.
Here it denotes a proposed narrowing of identity-maintenance and revision capacities, not data capture, military capture, attention alone, or persuasion alone.

hmmm: Canonical spelling, pluralization, and whether the directory name becomes an independent project name.
Operational invariants sufficient to identify one lineage across substantial mutation.
Validated separation of deep identification, adaptive commitment, dependency, and identity capture.
The damage-affordance coupling matrix and whether susceptibility changes are directional, nonlinear, or context-specific.
The existence, location, and hysteresis of coalescence thresholds.
Criteria for accountable distributed I status.
Ethically admissible empirical methods beyond synthetic and archival work.
Exact current canonical source identity for The Interdependent Way self-audit.
